🌎 BEYOND THE 956

The co-owner of a Killeen daycare has been arrested on a charge of possession of child pornography, according to the Temple Police Department.

Damien Ross Steinrich, 40, co-owner of Nurturing Nest Childcare in Killeen, was taken into custody after officers with the Temple Police Department and the Killeen Police Department executed a search warrant on October 7, 2026, at a residence in the 500 block of Tally Ho Road in Killeen. During the search, officers seized multiple electronic devices belonging to Steinrich that are suspected of containing child sexual abuse material.

Steinrich was taken to the Killeen City Jail on a charge of possession of child pornography and was transferred to the Bell County Jail on October 10. He is being held on a $150,000 bond. The charge is an allegation, and Steinrich is presumed innocent until proven guilty in court.

The Temple Police Department's Special Crimes Unit is investigating the case and coordinating with Child Protective Services and licensing agencies regarding Nurturing Nest Childcare, a daycare facility in Killeen owned by Steinrich and his wife. The daycare remains open, according to the department.

Investigators have not established a connection between the material on the devices and the daycare, or the Hutto Youth Baseball and Softball Association, where Steinrich reportedly coached. Police said they are working to identify potential victims, and that if additional evidence establishes a connection, the department will coordinate with the appropriate agencies to ensure affected individuals and families are notified.

Sources: Temple Police Department; KWTX; KCEN.
